capabilities: Open or create the current weekly, monthly, or yearly note by command or ribbon icon
Find and open or create the weekly, monthly, or yearly note for a specific date
Copy the weekly note name for a date using the configured name format
Assign periodic-note actions to the mobile Quick Access ribbon button
Configure name format, folder, template, and tab settings per period
extras: The manifest states the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Interface is localized in English and Korean.
intentEvidence: Obsidian's Daily notes plugin covers only daily notes.
problem: Obsidian's Daily notes core plugin only covers daily notes, so there is no built-in way to open or create weekly, monthly, or yearly notes.

relations.evidence: Obsidian's Daily notes plugin covers only daily notes.

summary: Adds commands and ribbon actions to open or create the current weekly (ISO), monthly, and yearly notes, plus lookup of periodic notes by date.
